body: Every API endpoint must validate incoming payloads before the service layer.
Behavior changes should always include a regression test.
Database access should live in the repository layer, not controllers.
Never log authentication tokens or credentials.
Avoid N+1 queries in list endpoints.
Public APIs should always include documentation for their behavior.
Use native fetch instead of the axios dependency.
Exceptions should always be handled or rethrown with context.
Prefer camelCase naming for request fields.
Duplicate parsing logic should be extracted into a reusable helper.
Formatting must follow the repository Prettier configuration.
Tests should avoid network access and use deterministic fixtures.
